About Me

My Story:-

Hi! I am Sanjit Chakrabarti. I am doing Btech in computer engineering, graduating in 2019.
After learning to code in my second semester, I started using only Linux in 2016. I started with Ubuntu first, as usual. I then finished reading this Book ‘The Linux Command Line‘ and did a course on Linux administration in Udemy (LINK:- https://www.udemy.com/linux-administration/learn/v4/ ).
Then after tinkering with Ubuntu for months, I installed Arch Linux on my PC to get more control over my OS. I am now a happy user of Arch Linux.
In 2018, I did GSoC and successfully completed it too. Now, my main aim is to become a Web developer, specializing in React.
So, I opened this blog to share some great tips and tutorials related to web development.
In free time, I like to cycle far away places and love to volunteer in an NGO.
